tickets.subject: Unable to download invoice PDF from billing portal

conversation.author: customer
conversation.body: The invoice PDF for August won't download, it just spins forever on the billing page.

conversation.author: agent
conversation.body: Thanks for flagging this, Priya. Could you confirm which browser and whether you're on the new billing portal (v2)?

conversation.author: customer
conversation.body: Chrome on Windows, and yes it's the v2 portal.

conversation.author: agent
conversation.body: Found it — this was a caching bug on our CDN for the v2 portal. Fixed and deployed. You should be able to download now.

tickets.subject: Account locked after failed MFA attempts

conversation.author: customer
conversation.body: My account got locked after I mistyped my authenticator code a few times. I need access before my 10am call.

conversation.author: agent
conversation.body: I've escalated this to identity ops for an expedited unlock. You'll receive a reset link at your registered email shortly.

tickets.subject: Question about data export retention period

conversation.author: customer
conversation.body: How long do you retain exported data files before they're purged from the download bucket?

conversation.author: agent
conversation.body: Exports are retained for 30 days from generation, then automatically purged. Let me know if you'd like a longer retention window for your plan.
